R9660.summary: The Duke of Sessa, imperial ambassador in Rome, to Charles V, from his duchy: no contemporary decipherment and not calendared by Bergenroth. Transcribed in full and deciphered in part (about 57%) with the 1524 Sessa key; the file gives each cipher line (a) with its reading (b), open groups in [ ]; it opens on letters sent 'por via de Francia' and 'la letra al duque de Bari'.

R9661-R9666.summary: A mostly clear letter on the arrest of Cardinal Soderini of Volterra, with three short cipher runs, all read: 'Su Santidad por esta bula es declarado contra Francia' (confirmed by a contemporary margin note), the Cardinal of Ancona 'muy buen servidor de V. Mt.', and 'Su Sd. mejoro ayer'. The other records of this group (R9661-R9664) are duplicates of letters Bergenroth calendared from the court's decipherments (CSP Spain 2 nos. 534, 540, 541, 544); their ciphers are not transcribed here, and R9666 is clear.
R9661-R9666.en:
this so good demonstration was made: ⟦His Holiness, by this bull, is declared against France⟧; seeing taken … and
shown … by Your Majesty …

… for cardinals in his chamber, and especially ⟦[?those] the one of Ancona⟧; in this case he has behaved as a very good
servant of Your Majesty.

… ⟦His Holiness was better yesterday.⟧

snip.cap: RAH Salazar A-27 f. 141r, Sessa to Charles V, 20 February 1523: code groups with clear words left inside the cipher, estonces dava, mas con color

system: The Sessa-Charles V nomenclator of 1523-25: three-letter code groups for words and syllables plus a letter alphabet with homophones, a clear/cipher switch sign and a null paragraph opener.
